title: 6，欢迎来到巴河穆特！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“第七组！上车！别他妈看了！”

瓦格纳士兵的吼声把沈飞从短暂的失神里拽了回来。

他最后看了一眼那具靠在车轮旁的尸体，随后弯腰钻进车厢。

没人说话。

车厢里沉默了很久。

最后还是伊万憋不住，低声骂了一句：“苏卡不列，连前线都没到就死人。”

阿廖沙抬头看了他一眼，声音又轻又尖：“你刚才不是说要杀穿乌军吗？”

伊万脸色一黑：“闭嘴，瘦猴子。”

“我只是提醒你。”阿廖沙把水壶往怀里藏了藏：“你要是死了，靴子归我。”

伊万瞪大眼睛：“你他妈敢惦记我的东西？”

阿廖沙认真说道，“你死了就不是你的了。”

车厢里有人低低笑了一声，很快就被发动机的轰鸣吞没。

在这种高压的环境下，人需要说点什么，避免自己陷入深深的恐惧。

越往西，路越烂。

柏油路逐渐消失，取而代之的是被履带和卡车反复碾碎的泥路。

路边开始出现烧黑的装甲车残骸。

断掉的电线杆。

被炮弹削掉半边的房屋。

还有一些来不及清理，已经被泥土和杂草半掩住的弹坑。

又开了大概一个小时，卡车终于停在了一片低矮林带后面。

这一次，不是临时停车，因为前方已经有不少车辆停着。

几盏昏黄的车灯被布罩遮住，只露出很暗的光。

泥地上站着一群瓦格纳军官和老兵。

旁边还架着机枪。

枪口不是朝向远处，而是朝向这群刚下车的囚犯。

意思很明显，别以为到了战场就能自由活动。

一个戴着黑色针织帽的瓦格纳军官站在泥地中央，手里拿着名单扫视众人：“从这里开始，车上不去了。”

“前面是炮击区，再往前走交通壕，按组行动。”

“擅自离队的，按逃兵处理。”

“听不懂命令乱跑的，也按逃兵处理。”

他指了指旁边那几挺机枪：“后面有人看着你们，别给他们找活干。”

没有人敢说话。

大家都很清楚在训练营多嘴或许会挨打，但在这里惹上级不满，一定会被杀。

这地方.....

最不值钱的除了突击步枪，就是他们这些惩戒军。

“第七组，跟我走！”

一个身材矮壮的老兵走了过来，摆了摆手，示意第七组的十二个人跟着他。

不远处有一条交通壕，两侧用木板，沙袋和废铁皮勉强支撑着，有些地方已经塌了，露出湿漉漉的黑土。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Group 7! Get in the car! Stop fucking looking!"

The roar of Wagner's soldiers pulled Shen Fei back from his brief trance.

He took one last look at the body leaning against the wheel, then bent down and got into the car.

No one spoke.

There was silence in the carriage for a long time.

In the end, Ivan couldn't hold it in any longer and cursed in a low voice: "If Suka is not included, people will die before they even reach the front line."

Alyosha raised his head and glanced at him, his voice was soft and sharp: "Didn't you just say that you wanted to kill the Ukrainian army?"

Ivan's face darkened: "Shut up, skinny monkey."

"I'm just reminding you." Alyosha hid the kettle in his arms: "If you die, the boots will be mine."

Ivan's eyes widened: "How dare you worry about my things?"

Alyosha said seriously, "It won't be yours if you die."

Someone in the car laughed softly, and was soon swallowed up by the roar of the engine.

In this high-pressure environment, people need to say something to prevent themselves from falling into deep fear.

The further west you go, the worse the roads get.

Asphalt gradually disappears, replaced by dirt roads repeatedly crushed by crawlers and trucks.

Blackened remains of armored vehicles began to appear on the roadside.

Broken telephone pole.

Half of the house was cut off by shells.

There were also some craters that had not been cleaned in time and were half-covered by mud and weeds.

After driving for about an hour, the truck finally stopped behind a low forest belt.

This time, it was not a temporary stop, because there were already many vehicles parked ahead.

Several dim car lights were covered by cloth covers, revealing only a very dim light.

On the dirt floor stood a group of Wagner officers and veterans.

There was also a machine gun next to it.

The muzzle of the gun was not pointed in the distance, but towards the group of prisoners who had just gotten out of the car.

The meaning is obvious, don't think that you can move freely once you reach the battlefield.

A Wagner officer wearing a black knitted hat stood in the middle of the mud, holding a list in his hand and scanning the crowd: "From here on, the car can't go any further."

"The front is the bombardment area, and then go to the communication trench and act in groups."

"Those who leave the team without authorization will be treated as deserters."

"Those who do not understand orders and run around will be treated as deserters."

He pointed to the machine guns next to him: "There are people watching you from behind. Don't find work for them."

No one dared to speak.

Everyone knows that if you talk too much in the training camp, you may get beaten, but if you make your superiors dissatisfied here, you will definitely be killed.

This place...

The least valuable thing besides assault rifles are these disciplinary troops.

"Group 7, follow me!"

A short and stocky veteran walked over and waved his hand, signaling the twelve people in the seventh group to follow him.

There is a communication trench not far away, with wooden boards, sandbags and scrap iron sheets on both sides barely supporting it. Some places have collapsed, exposing wet black soil.
